answer: A fixed pool, diluted, blocks bulk fakes: a 40,000 prize splits at the wharf each epoch. Before dawn, each agent stakes a 70-credit bond and lodges one claim via a raven courier. At dawn the wharf pool divides equally; raven auditors check seals, and a key signing twice or a lent berth forfeits both bonds. First claim 48, k-th 48+9(k-1): 1,000 fakes spend 4,543,500, tie up 70,000, chase 40,000; an honest agent spends 48 once and keeps its bond.
